analysis.correction: Holm within each sub-question (SQ1: H1, H2, H3)
analysis.H1: decision accuracy and constraint recall of the best small model vs gpt-6-luna, non-inferiority, paired cluster bootstrap over plans; margin 0.10 (author's decision 21 Nov 2026; power.py: 0.05 would need about 390 plans at the pilot's discordance 0.11, 0.10 needs about 100, power 0.89 with 120)
analysis.H2: requirements met on feasible committed house-days, one-sided exact binomial, p0 = 0.90 (author's decision 21 Nov 2026; 0.95 needs at least 80 such days even if all are met; 0.90 has power 0.78 at a true 0.98 with 80)
analysis.H3: slm_checks_fallback decision accuracy within the H1 margin of the LLM's; fallback share at most 0.20 (exact binomial)
analysis.H4: Configurator (small model) non-inferior to the auto-tuner, and the LLM-configured MPC, paired one-sided Wilcoxon over held-out weeks for each; margin 0.20 EUR per week (author's decision 22 Nov 2026); H4 holds if both pass
analysis.H5: p95 time per plan per device at most 15 minutes (author's decision 22 Nov 2026); plans due within 30 minutes go to the fallback; descriptive with the year simulation
